answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the economy isolates fake clusters using topological cut verifications across an interaction graph: each cluster is quarantined like a lagoon of suspect traffic. Independent auditor agents stake valuable sable bonds to conduct game-theoretic multi-agent auditing on boundary cut edges. When cut verification exposes coordinated fraud, auditor quorum triggers stake slashing, making attacker cost scale exponentially with cluster size and sending a plume of penalty burns through the network.
